content.comment_body: I have managed to establish contact between my [product_name] and [product_name] via the OPC server. I can read the OPC address S7:[TEST]IW0 and receive the correct value from the [product_name]. When I try using OPC address S7:[TEST]VW0, the quality is poor. My question is: How can I access the variable memory (VM) from the [product_name] using the OPC server?
If VW0 doesn't provide good results, you may want to try DB1.DBW0. The Variable Memory in [product_name] functions similarly to DB1.

analysis.insight_summary: The user successfully connects their [product_name] device to [product_name] using OPC and can read input values, but has difficulty accessing variable memory addresses, which leads to poor-quality data. There is confusion over the appropriate address format for retrieving variable memory via OPC, and another user offers an alternative address suggestion.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to reliably read the variable memory of their [product_name] device using OPC through [product_name], with accurate addressing instructions and clear documentation.
